claim_scope: guardrail: primary adverse-leaning readings (a1->b1 adverse on all four stats) rejected on disagreeing directions/drift and did not reproduce in rerun 0225r (p50/mean/p95 accepted favorable) - cleared by rerun; no claim

protocol.processes: one fresh process per A/B/B/A leg; samples within each leg run in-process
protocol.acceptance: a statistic is accepted only when candidate elapsed time is lower in both paired directions and control/candidate same-implementation drift stays within that statistic's threshold
protocol.percentiles: p50 = statistics.median; p95/p99 = nearest-rank (tools/perf_compare.py method); drift = (second_leg - first_leg) / first_leg

binaries.note: control is the banked 0224 binary; candidate adds the 0225 text-path resolution memo in litchi-odt

provenance.source_state: HEAD c6b94046e (banked through 0224, both binaries); the candidate additionally carries the 0225 text-path resolution memo in litchi-odt

timing_scope: filesystem_read_or_path_open_and_unified_document_ownership_inside_timer; corpus, temporary-file setup, semantic parity, archive identity, and source replay outside timer
verification: harness-embedded corpus hash identical across legs; in-harness semantic/read-evidence gates passed on every leg (a failed gate aborts the leg with a non-zero exit)
